page.overview:
Who is Baby Ankylosaurus?

The baby Ankylosaurus is held by a dinosaur handler while it is on display.

The baby raptor can sometimes be spotted as a meet and greet encounter at the park, where she can be joined by the baby Triceratops and raptor, alongside an adult Triceratops, Stegosaurus and a pack of Velociraptors.
